If $\delta$ is a normal
$\Log{N2c}$ or $\Log{N2i}$-!!{proof} of~$\Gamma \Sequent !A$ then
there is a (cut-free) $\Log{G2c}$-!!{proof}
($\Log{G2i}$-!!{proof})~$\pi$ of $\Gamma' \Sequent \Delta$, where
$\Gamma'$ is the multiset of !!{formula}s resulting from $\Gamma$ by
removing labels, and $\Delta = \{!A\}$ if $!A$ is not~$\lfalse$, and
$\Delta = \emptyset$ if it is.
